# Settings reference

Every setting is an environment variable with the `ROR_` prefix (`roracle.config.Settings`). "Runtime" marks settings an admin can override at runtime (`roracle.runtime.SettingsIn`); a stored override wins over the environment. Secrets are shown as `***`.

| Env var | Type | Default | Runtime | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ROR_AGENTIC_ANSWER_RESERVE_S` | `float` | `20.0` |  | MCP `ask`: time kept for the answer out of `global_mcp_budget_s` |
| `ROR_AGENTIC_CALL_TIMEOUT_S` | `float` | `1.5` |  | one planner call, also bounded by the remaining deadline (slower = dropped) |
| `ROR_AGENTIC_MAX_ADMITTED` | `int` | `4` |  | loops admitted per process at once (one per user); the rest take the fact path |
| `ROR_AGENTIC_MAX_PARALLEL` | `int` | `4` |  | sub-query retrievals in flight, process-wide (own sessions) |
| `ROR_AGENTIC_MAX_STEPS` | `int` | `3` |  | planner rounds after the first retrieval |
| `ROR_AGENTIC_MAX_SUBQUERIES` | `int` | `4` |  | sub-queries per planner round |
| `ROR_AGENTIC_PLANNER_MODEL` | `str` | `''` |  | a SMALL FAST model (dev: qwen2.5:3b); empty = the first chat model (slower). Its latency is the per-round budget |
| `ROR_AGENTIC_RETRIEVAL` | `bool` | `False` | yes | P13 T8: query decomposition loop on multihop questions (flips on a PASS) |
| `ROR_AGENTIC_TIMEOUT_S` | `float` | `30.0` |  | deadline of the whole loop (the first retrieval always completes) |
| `ROR_API_THREADS` | `int` | `256` |  | anyio worker-thread tokens: one per in-flight sync route or SSE stream |
| `ROR_BUILD_CONCURRENCY` | `int` | `2` |  | concurrent draft builds per api process; more = 503 busy |
| `ROR_BUILD_MAX_PDF_BYTES` | `int` | `104857600` |  | Maximum size of a built draft PDF in bytes |
| `ROR_BUILD_TIMEOUT_S` | `float` | `120.0` |  | per pandoc call and for the Gotenberg request |
| `ROR_CHAT_CANDIDATES` | `int` | `200` |  | BM25 and kNN list size on the chat path |
| `ROR_CHAT_MIN_SIMILARITY` | `float` | `0.35` |  | kNN floor for chat retrieval; 0 disables |
| `ROR_CHAT_MODELS` | `str` | `'qwen2.5:14b'` | yes | comma-separated; first is the default |
| `ROR_CHAT_NOTE_MIN_RATIO` | `float` | `0.6` | yes | Minimum upvote ratio for a community note to reach the LLM |
| `ROR_CHAT_NOTE_MIN_UPVOTES` | `int` | `3` | yes | community notes reach the LLM only above these (own notes always) |
| `ROR_CHAT_PASSAGES` | `int` | `8` | yes | clamped 4-12 at use |
| `ROR_CLAMAV_HOST` | `str` | `''` |  | ClamAV host for upload scanning; empty = scanning off |
| `ROR_CLAMAV_PORT` | `int` | `3310` |  | ClamAV port |
| `ROR_CONNECTOR_FS_ROOTS` | `list[str]` | `[]` |  | fs connectors may only read under these |
| `ROR_CONNECTOR_HTTP_ALLOW_CIDRS` | `list[str]` | `[]` |  | http crawl may reach these private ranges |
| `ROR_CONNECTOR_HTTP_TIMEOUT_S` | `int` | `60` |  | per HTTP request (connect to last byte) |
| `ROR_CONNECTOR_MAX_ITEMS` | `int` | `1000` |  | per run |
| `ROR_CONNECTOR_MAX_RUN_S` | `int` | `3600` |  | Maximum duration in seconds of one connector run |
| `ROR_CONNECTOR_TICK_S` | `int` | `60` |  | Seconds between connector scheduler ticks |
| `ROR_CONTEXT_CONCURRENCY` | `int` | `8` |  | context-note LLM calls in flight per document |
| `ROR_CONTEXT_DOC_CHARS` | `int` | `24000` |  | document window sent in the stable prefix |
| `ROR_CONTEXT_MAX_CHUNKS` | `int` | `400` |  | per document; later chunks get the heading path (bounds one job) |
| `ROR_CONTEXT_MAX_TOKENS` | `int` | `120` |  | hard cap per note |
| `ROR_CONTEXT_MODEL` | `str` | `''` |  | empty = notes off (needs an Ollama variant with num_ctx >= 16384) |
| `ROR_CONTEXT_NOTES` | `bool` | `False` |  | P13 T5: LLM situating note per chunk (flips on a PASS in docs/eval/) |
| `ROR_DATABASE_PASSWORD` | `str` | `''` |  | injected into database_url when set (keeps the secret out of the URL) |
| `ROR_DATABASE_URL` | `str` | (required) |  | SQLAlchemy URL of the PostgreSQL database (postgresql:// is rewritten to postgresql+psycopg://) |
| `ROR_DB_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_S` | `int` | `5` |  | PG connect timeout (api/worker/readyz); a ?connect_timeout= in the URL wins |
| `ROR_DB_DISABLE_PREPARED` | `bool` | `False` |  | True behind PgBouncer transaction pooling (set by the chart with the pooler) |
| `ROR_DB_MAX_OVERFLOW` | `int` | `4` |  | Extra API-process connections beyond the pool |
| `ROR_DB_POOL_SIZE` | `int` | `8` |  | api process |
| `ROR_DB_POOL_TIMEOUT_S` | `float` | `10.0` |  | wait for a pooled connection before failing the request (503-ish) |
| `ROR_DOCLING_TIMEOUT_S` | `float` | `300.0` |  | Docling request timeout in seconds |
| `ROR_DOCLING_URL` | `str` | `'http://localhost:5001'` |  | Docling (document conversion) service URL |
| `ROR_DRAFT_GOTENBERG_URL` | `str` | `''` |  | separate Chromium-enabled Gotenberg for draft PDF builds; empty = 503 |
| `ROR_DRAFT_MAX_BYTES` | `int` | `2097152` |  | P9 draft Markdown cap (UTF-8) |
| `ROR_ELASTIC_CA_CERTS` | `str` | `''` |  | path to a PEM CA bundle for ES TLS |
| `ROR_ELASTIC_PASSWORD` | `str` | `''` |  | Elasticsearch basic-auth password (secret) |
| `ROR_ELASTIC_URL` | `str` | `'http://localhost:9200'` |  | Elasticsearch base URL |
| `ROR_ELASTIC_USERNAME` | `str` | `''` |  | Elasticsearch basic-auth user; empty = none |
| `ROR_EMBED_CACHE_SIZE` | `int` | `10000` |  | query embeddings memoized in process (0 = off) |
| `ROR_EMBED_CACHE_TTL_S` | `float` | `600.0` |  | Seconds a memoized query embedding stays valid |
| `ROR_EMBED_CONCURRENCY` | `int` | `4` |  | embedding requests in flight during re-embed/rebuild (~replicas) |
| `ROR_EMBED_DIMS` | `int` | `768` |  | Embedding vector dimensions |
| `ROR_EMBED_INDEX` | `str` | `''` |  | active ES index; set only by re-embed cutover (runtime override), "" = derived |
| `ROR_EMBED_MODEL` | `str` | `'embeddinggemma'` |  | Embedding model name |
| `ROR_EMBED_QUERY_RETRIES` | `int` | `0` |  | 0 on the interactive path; the eval runner sets batch retries |
| `ROR_EMBED_TOKENIZER` | `str` | `'sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2'` |  | Tokenizer used to size chunks for the embedding model |
| `ROR_ES_EXCLUDE_SOURCE_VECTORS` | `bool` | `True` |  | vectors stay out of _source (rehydrated for reindex); ES >= 9.2 |
| `ROR_ES_HNSW_FILTER_HEURISTIC` | `Literal['acorn', 'fan_out']` | `'acorn'` |  | filtered kNN: ACORN traverses matching nodes only |
| `ROR_ES_REFRESH_INTERVAL` | `str` | `'5s'` |  | Elasticsearch index refresh_interval |
| `ROR_ES_REPLICAS` | `int` | `1` |  | Replica count for newly created indices |
| `ROR_ES_SHARDS` | `int` | `1` |  | ~30-50 GB per shard (docs/enterprise/capacity-planning.md) |
| `ROR_EVAL_JUDGE_MODEL` | `str` | `''` |  | P13 LLM judge; empty = first chat model |
| `ROR_EVAL_JUDGE_SAMPLE` | `int` | `100` |  | (query x principal) pairs judged per run |
| `ROR_EVAL_ON_REINDEX` | `bool` | `True` |  | enqueue `eval_run` on the reference set after a re-embed cutover |
| `ROR_EVIDENCE_MAX_BYTES` | `int` | `1073741824` |  | notes evidence file cap (1 GiB) |
| `ROR_GLOBAL_CALL_TIMEOUT_S` | `float` | `20.0` |  | per map call, also bounded by the question's remaining deadline |
| `ROR_GLOBAL_CONCURRENCY` | `int` | `8` |  | parallel map calls of ONE global question |
| `ROR_GLOBAL_DOC_CHARS` | `int` | `6000` |  | one document's own text sent per map call |
| `ROR_GLOBAL_MAP_TOKENS` | `int` | `200` |  | hard cap per map note |
| `ROR_GLOBAL_MAX_ADMITTED` | `int` | `4` |  | global questions admitted per process at once (the rest take the fact path) |
| `ROR_GLOBAL_MAX_CONCURRENT` | `int` | `16` |  | process-wide cap on in-flight map calls (all users); busy => fact path |
| `ROR_GLOBAL_MAX_DOCS` | `int` | `40` |  | Maximum documents mapped for one global question |
| `ROR_GLOBAL_MCP_BUDGET_S` | `float` | `45.0` |  | MCP `ask` global budget (clients time out near 60 s) |
| `ROR_GLOBAL_REDUCE_TOKENS` | `int` | `1200` |  | hard cap on the streamed reduce answer |
| `ROR_GLOBAL_TIMEOUT_S` | `float` | `90.0` |  | Overall deadline in seconds of one global question |
| `ROR_GOTENBERG_TIMEOUT_S` | `float` | `300.0` |  | Gotenberg request timeout in seconds |
| `ROR_GOTENBERG_URL` | `str` | `''` |  | Gotenberg (office-to-PDF rendition) service URL; empty = disabled |
| `ROR_GROBID_TIMEOUT_S` | `float` | `120.0` |  | GROBID request timeout in seconds |
| `ROR_GROBID_URL` | `str` | `''` |  | GROBID (bibliographic metadata) service URL; empty = disabled |
| `ROR_JOB_DRAIN_S` | `float` | `0.0` |  | after SIGTERM a running job gets this long, then it is released (0 = wait) |
| `ROR_JOB_LEASE_S` | `float` | `90.0` |  | a running job's lease; the worker heartbeat renews it every lease/3 |
| `ROR_LATEX_BUILDER` | `Literal['disabled']` | `'disabled'` |  | `disabled` -> format: latex builds return 501 |
| `ROR_LLM_API_KEY` | `str` | *** |  | API key sent to the LLM endpoint (secret) |

| `ROR_MAINTENANCE_INTERVAL_S` | `int` | `86400` |  | periodic purge + blob gc + tag reconcile |
| `ROR_MAX_RENDITION_BYTES` | `int` | `524288000` |  | Maximum size of a generated PDF rendition in bytes |
| `ROR_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES` | `int` | `524288000` | yes | Maximum size of one uploaded file in bytes |
| `ROR_MCP_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES` | `int` | `26214400` |  | MCP upload tool: decoded file cap (base64 body) |
| `ROR_MUTATE_ALIAS` | `str` | `'chunks-all'` |  | Elasticsearch alias used for ACL update_by_query and writes |
| `ROR_NEAR_DUP_SUMMARY_THRESHOLD` | `float` | `0.97` | yes | Summary-similarity threshold for near-duplicate detection |

| `ROR_PATS_ENABLED` | `bool` | `True` | yes | Allow personal access tokens (agent/MCP access) |
| `ROR_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` | `str` | `''` |  | externally visible origin, e.g. https://roracle.example.org |
| `ROR_RAPTOR` | `bool` | `False` |  | P13 T6: per-document section/document summary units (flips on a PASS in docs/eval/) |
| `ROR_RAPTOR_MAX_SECTIONS` | `int` | `64` |  | section units per document (adjacent sections are folded) |
| `ROR_RAPTOR_MODEL` | `str` | `''` |  | empty = summary_model |

| `ROR_REEMBED_SLICES` | `int` | `4` |  | parallel chunk_id slices of a re-embed (one job chain each) |
